title: paeonia delavayi f. lutea
intro: Paeonia delavayi f. lutea, commonly known as the yellow-flowered tree peony, is a variant of the Paeonia delavayi species, a type of flowering plant in the peony family (Paeoniaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain, swelling, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia delavayi f. lutea are believed to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which have been shown to possess analgesic, antispasmodic, and sedative properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Paeonia delavayi f. lutea on human health and its potential applications in traditional medicine.
